testcase.name: Scenario: Select a face while keyboard tips are displayed: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:483:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a face while keyboard tips are displayed ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed with the Modify area closed ✔ When the user presses Alt, then M, then Y ✔ And the user clicks a visible solid face outside the expanded area ✔ Then the Modify additional command area remains visible with keyboard tips displayed ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the keyboard tips and Modify additional command area close ✔ And the clicked face is visibly selected ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the face selection is cleared
